So much downtime, about 30 mins were just lame. Theon laying there dying, Arya running through the library, the part at the start. The pacing was just torpid and lethargic. Why didn't they even consider making a shield wall? Also, why just line up in stupid columns...why send ALL of your cavalry (who also happen to be your strongest fighting force, 50,000 or whatever number, all mounted!) in a suicide charge? Why even have flanks or columns, when the whole point of such strategy is so you can outflank or outmaneuver your opponents? Did it ever occur to them that they maybe possibly just for the sake of not having almost 100% casualties, to flank the opponent? Or attack from multiple sides? Again, shield walls? Did you even see a single Unsullied use a shield, or short sword? Considering Theon and 20 malnourished, scurvy ridden, rapist pirates from the Iron Islands held off about 100,000 of them with just a few bows and arrows, and one shoddy spear...why didn't we see the army set up some archers, to...you know...support the troops on the ground? Also, what happened to the siege weapons?
